[d/g4968383dc452-1] decision (cited, source nodejs/README.md@4968383dc452)
  Upgrade nodejs conformance target from C-Read to C-Produce.

[d/g4968383dc452-12] decision (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@4968383dc452)
  Correct README claims that tables were asserted against document.

[d/g4968383dc452-15] decision (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@4968383dc452)
  Revise gate 7 blocked command explanation, no longer 'decision about book'.

[d/g4968383dc452-16] decision (cited, source git:4968383dc452dba3c9ac9ab2c6abae4b3612bba5)
  Hold beta.smy repair rather than guess missing stanza.
  -> causes q/g4968383dc452-16-1

[d/g4968383dc452-17] decision (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@4968383dc452)
  Do not implement rule M in outside readers.
  -> causes q/g4968383dc452-17-1

[d/g4968383dc452-21] decision (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@4968383dc452)
  Do not apply 22% artefact fraction to other modules.

[d/g4968383dc452-23] decision (cited, source nodejs/src/uid.js@4968383dc452)
  Implement status integers and source/kind enums as constants in nodejs.

[d/g4968383dc452-24] decision (cited, source Documentation/SMYSL_FORMAT_SPEC.md@4968383dc452)
  Implement RFC 4648 base32 alphabet in nodejs.
  -> causes q/g4968383dc452-24-1

[d/g4968383dc452-8] decision (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@4968383dc452)
  Mark spec-derived constants with SPEC: in nodejs src/uid.js.
  To record that these values were previously guessed from fixtures, making the method explicit.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-12] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update format spec §8.5 to record the version-trap defect as fixed in 0.14.
  -> causes q/g69ea5c05d859-12-1

[d/g69ea5c05d859-14] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Defer flipping the writer default to smysl/1.0 until 0.14 is published.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-15] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Do not add version lists to python/, nodejs/, go/ implementations.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-6] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Pass the parsed format_version from ParseOutcome to WriteContext in `smysl fmt`.

[d/g69ea5c05d859-8] decision (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Update smysl-core unit tests to loop over FORMAT_VERSIONS_SUPPORTED and reject non-listed near misses (e.g. …
  The old test asserted a literal list and used smysl/1.0 as an unknown version. Driving it from the actual list makes it grow with the list instead of failing or silently passing on new versions.

[d/g87345653cdf3-1] decision (cited, source fuzz/fuzz_targets/pack_exact.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Build Constraints via default and field assignment instead of struct literal

[d/g87345653cdf3-11] decision (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Compile out the doc output test outside the default-ish feature set
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-11-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-2] decision (cited, source fuzz/fuzz_targets/pack_exact.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Remove unused BTreeSet import from pack_exact.rs

[d/g87345653cdf3-4] decision (cited, source git:87345653cdf330199730f4e8a0afe2275902ad11)
  Make `make ci` depend on fuzz-build
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-4-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-6] decision (cited, source git:87345653cdf330199730f4e8a0afe2275902ad11)
  Do not run fuzzers as part of make ci; only compile them
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-6-1

[d/g87345653cdf3-7] decision (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  Make verify-doc-output.py binary path overridable via SMYSL_BIN
  This lets the new cargo test pass the binary cargo built for it, so mutation testing exercises the mutated binary rather than a stale one.

[d/g87345653cdf3-8] decision (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  Fix path extraction in verify-doc-output.py to skip token 0

[d/g87345653cdf3-9] decision (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  Add tests/doc_output.rs so cargo test runs the doc output replay
  -> causes q/g87345653cdf3-9-1

[d/g90ec2f781421-10] decision (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@90ec2f781421)
  Update CHANGELOG, READINESS, and ROAD_TO_1.0 to record dispatch pass findings.

[d/g90ec2f781421-12] decision (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@90ec2f781421)
  Do not change tests/doc_output.rs gating to run under --all-features.
  -> causes q/g90ec2f781421-12-1

[d/g90ec2f781421-2] decision (cited, source git:90ec2f781421002876548124e9fe02073503372c)
  Compare all 380 arguments against a golden CLI surface inside cargo test.

[d/g90ec2f781421-3] decision (cited, source Makefile@90ec2f781421)
  Hardcode command names in tests and Makefile instead of deriving from --help.

[d/g90ec2f781421-4] decision (cited, source git:90ec2f781421002876548124e9fe02073503372c)
  Run each command in a scratch directory of its own.

[d/g90ec2f781421-5] decision (cited, source tests/dispatch.rs@90ec2f781421)
  Supply minimal_args for required-argument commands and treat clap refusal as failure.
  Seven commands require arguments; bare name rejected before router. import not covered elsewhere and mutant survived. Treating refusal as failure prevents future coverage drop.

[d/g90ec2f781421-6] decision (cited, source tests/dispatch.rs@90ec2f781421)
  Set stdin to /dev/null for dispatch test commands.

[d/g90ec2f781421-7] decision (cited, source src/main.rs@90ec2f781421)
  Document the `==` to `!=` mutation of COMMANDS.iter().find as equivalent.
  -> causes q/g90ec2f781421-7-1

[d/g90ec2f781421-8] decision (cited, source src/main.rs@90ec2f781421)
  Do not add a test to distinguish the equivalent `!=` mutation.
  -> causes q/g90ec2f781421-8-1

[d/g90ec2f781421-9] decision (cited, source tests/dispatch.rs@90ec2f781421)
  Do not assert exit code in every_command_dispatches.
  Most commands fail without a store; how they fail is rest of suite's job. Claim only that failure came from command not router.

[d/ga18e230ae345-3] decision (cited, source git:a18e230ae34564f0a3d93538cf1a557b68a3f5aa)
  Decline to keep the search that measured the pass.

[d/ga18e230ae345-5] decision (cited, source crates/smysl-pack/src/solve.rs@a18e230ae345)
  Add a comment explaining the removal in place of the loop.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-5-1

[d/ga18e230ae345-6] decision (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@a18e230ae345)
  Document the removal in the changelog.
  -> causes q/ga18e230ae345-6-1

[e/g69ea5c05d859-9-1] evidence (cited, source git:69ea5c05d85933ca248ea9ca78669f8a76e2ed7e)
  Check: make ci green

[p/g4968383dc452-17-1] constraint (cited, source CHANGELOG.md@4968383dc452)
  Unit core carries grounds as uids, not statuses; rule M requires store.
  -> conditions d/g4968383dc452-17

[p/g4968383dc452-26-1] constraint (cited, source nodejs/src/uid.js@4968383dc452)
  Spec says deps/grounds are sets, deduplicated and sorted by uid bytes.

[p/g4968383dc452-8-1] constraint (cited, source nodejs/README.md@4968383dc452)
  The CBOR reader already marks spec-derived constants with SPEC:.
  -> conditions d/g4968383dc452-8

[p/g69ea5c05d859-8-1] constraint (cited, source crates/smysl-core/src/lib.rs@69ea5c05d859)
  Old unit test asserted smysl/1.0 as unknown version.
  -> conditions d/g69ea5c05d859-8

[p/g87345653cdf3-7-1] constraint (cited, source tests/doc_output.rs@87345653cdf3)
  cargo sets CARGO_BIN_EXE_smysl to the binary built for the integration test.
  -> conditions d/g87345653cdf3-7

[p/g90ec2f781421-5-1] constraint (cited, source git:90ec2f781421002876548124e9fe02073503372c)
  Seven commands require an argument, so clap rejects bare names before the router runs.
  -> conditions d/g90ec2f781421-5

[p/g90ec2f781421-9-1] constraint (cited, source tests/dispatch.rs@90ec2f781421)
  Most commands fail without a store, so exit code would only reflect command failure.
  -> conditions d/g90ec2f781421-9

[q/g4968383dc452-16-1] claim (inferred)
  beta.smy repair declined; missing stanza cannot be reconstructed from page.

[q/g4968383dc452-17-1] claim (inferred)
  Rule M not implemented; validate claiming it would be check that cannot fail.

[q/g4968383dc452-24-1] claim (inferred)
  RFC 4648 base32 alphabet implemented, avoiding mutually unreadable names.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-12-1] claim (inferred)
  Format spec §8.5 records version-trap defect fixed in 0.14.

[q/g69ea5c05d859-13-1] claim (inferred)
  Format spec §8.6 says smysl/1.0 is not a break; format settled rather than changed.

[q/g87345653cdf3-10-1] claim (inferred)
  Count assertion prevents gate from confusing nothing wrong with nothing checked.

[q/g87345653cdf3-11-1] claim (inferred)
  Compile out doc output test outside default feature set to avoid false drift.

[q/g87345653cdf3-4-1] claim (inferred)
  make ci depends on fuzz-build, so CI gates on fuzz compilation.

[q/g87345653cdf3-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Only compile fuzzers in CI; running remains separate due to nightly and time.

[q/g87345653cdf3-9-1] claim (inferred)
  Adding tests/doc_output.rs exposes replay to cargo test and coverage tools.

[q/g90ec2f781421-12-1] claim (inferred)
  Doc-output gating remains unchanged; design deliberate.

[q/g90ec2f781421-7-1] claim (inferred)
  Equivalent `!=` mutant documented instead of chased; records unreachability.

[q/g90ec2f781421-8-1] claim (inferred)
  No pointless test added for unreachable mutation; recorded rather than chased.

[q/ga18e230ae345-5-1] claim (inferred)
  A comment in solve.rs documents the removal rationale and measurements.

[q/ga18e230ae345-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Changelog records the removal under Unreleased 0.8.0.

[r/g4968383dc452-7-1] claim (cited, source Documentation/READINESS.md@4968383dc452)
  Rejected: Encode empty deps/grounds as empty arrays.
  A literal reading would produce a different uid for every unit with neither.

[r/g87345653cdf3-7-1] claim (cited, source scripts/verify-doc-output.py@87345653cdf3)
  Rejected: Hardcode the binary path as './target/debug/smysl'
  A stale binary would report every mutant as caught while testing none of them.
  -> contrasts d/g87345653cdf3-7

[r/g90ec2f781421-2-1] claim (cited, source git:90ec2f781421002876548124e9fe02073503372c)
  Rejected: first version of tests/dispatch.rs assumed the two arms were the same mutation; only invoked …
  It missed that deleting a cli() arm strips arguments, which a no-argument invocation cannot see.
  -> contrasts d/g90ec2f781421-2

[r/g90ec2f781421-4-1] claim (cited, source git:90ec2f781421002876548124e9fe02073503372c)
  Rejected: run each command in the repository root
  It left .smysl/staged.smy and .smysl/usage.log behind, and usage read a ledger ingest had just written.
  -> contrasts d/g90ec2f781421-4

[r/g90ec2f781421-9-1] claim (cited, source tests/dispatch.rs@90ec2f781421)
  Rejected: assert exit code in every_command_dispatches
  Most commands fail without a store; how they fail is the rest of the suite's job.
  -> contrasts d/g90ec2f781421-9
